policy_citations.section: SNF Level of Care - Definitions and Reference Guide › Definitions, Skilled need
policy_citations.quote: Skilled need: A service that requires the involvement of licensed nursing or therapy staff, and could not be safely or effectively provided by non-skilled caregivers.

policy_citations.quote: Revenue codes 0191-0194: Standard billing codes for the four SNF per-diem levels of care referenced in these guidelines: 0191 (skilled nursing), 0192 (rehabilitation therapy), 0193 (sub-acute), 0194 (weanable ventilator management).

policy_citations.quote: Non-covered day: A day within an otherwise covered stay where documentation does not support the billed level of care for that specific day; does not require the entire stay to be denied.

system_note: Billed line: revenue code 0192 (Rehabilitation therapy) for 5 days, 2026-08-05 through 2026-08-11. The facility's documented therapy on each date shows three therapy disciplines with identical daily totals: PT 90 minutes + OT 60 minutes + SLP 45 minutes = 195 total therapy minutes on each date 2026-08-05 through 2026-08-11 (get_daily_services result). The facility-level per-diem extraction (get_per_diem_level_notes) returned no date-specific level-determination statements (all null), which the tool notes commonly means the facility had no exception to document because the billed level's documentation thresholds were met. The payer-specific guideline for Aetna Medicare Advantage is not present in this dataset; the reviewer therefore applied the payer-agnostic SNF Level of Care Reference Guide. That guide defines a Skilled need as a service requiring licensed nursing or therapy staff and lists 0192 as the rehabilitation therapy per-diem code (RULE-Policy-Documents-SNF-Reference-Materials-SNF-Level-of-Care-Definitions-and-Reference-Guide.docx positions b6 and b8). Given (1) daily documentation of multidisciplinary licensed therapy on each billed date totaling 195 minutes/day, and (2) the Reference Guide's definition that rehabilitation therapy (0192) is the per-diem code for services requiring licensed therapists, the record supports the billed per-diem level for the entire 2026-08-05 to 2026-08-11 range. No individual date meets the Reference Guide's description of a Non-covered day (a day where documentation does not support the billed level) (RULE-Policy-Documents-SNF-Reference-Materials-SNF-Level-of-Care-Definitions-and-Reference-Guide.docx position b11). Therefore no downcoding, unit reduction, or date-range narrowing is indicated on this revenue-line based on the documentation available. Evidence relied on: daily therapy sessions (get_daily_services rows) showing PT/OT/SLP minutes each date and the SNF Level of Care Reference Guide definitions (evidence entries below). Reviewed billed revenue line 2 (0191) for 2026-08-05 through 2026-08-11 (1 day(s) on the line as submitted). The facility's daily documentation shows active licensed therapy each day of the date range (daily therapy sessions: PT 90 minutes, OT 60 minutes, SLP 45 minutes on each date 2026-08-05 through 2026-08-11 per the facility daily services extract). The SNF Level-of-Care reference guide defines skilled need as services requiring licensed nursing or therapy staff and lists revenue code 0191 as 'skilled nursing' and 0192 as 'rehabilitation therapy' (Policy: Revenue codes 0191-0194; Skilled need). The per-diem-level determination notes for each date were null (no facility-stated exception), which the tool's metadata explains commonly means the facility had no exception to document because the billed level/minutes threshold was met. Given (1) active licensed therapy documented on every date in the range (PT/OT/SLP minutes as above) demonstrating skilled services, (2) the facility did not record any per-diem downcode statements for these dates, and (3) the reference guide definition that skilled need is met by services requiring licensed therapy staff, the medical record supports the billed per-diem level for the full date range. No individual date meets criteria for denial or downcoding based on the retrieved documentation. Cited policy: RULE-Policy-Documents-SNF-Reference-Materials-SNF-Level-of-Care-Definitions-and-Reference-Guide.docx (fields: Skilled need; Revenue codes 0191-0194; Non-covered day).
